product.name: HUBUC Cloud Card Issuing Engine
product.description: A cloud-native platform for issuing and processing debit, credit, and prepaid cards with fast transaction processing and high availability.

product.name: Global Issuing Processing
product.description: A service providing authorization and processing for debit, prepaid, and credit card transactions with network integration and spend controls.

product.name: Clearing & Settlement Reporting
product.description: API-delivered transaction, authorization, settlement, and clearing reports in JSON or raw formats for reconciliation and analysis.

identifier.value: Physical and Virtual Cards with Apple Pay Support

product.name: Physical and Virtual Cards with Apple Pay Support
product.description: Issuance of physical and virtual cards with instant support for Apple Pay and security features like Dynamic CVV.

product.name: Virtual Travel Cards for OTAs
product.description: Virtual cards designed for online travel agencies to automate payments, manage multiple providers, and generate cashback revenue.

product.name: HUBUC RTSA (Real-time Streaming Auth)
product.description: A real-time streaming authorization system with dynamic card-level settings for activation, spend velocity, and limits.
